info.description: Community carpooling API. Run "Auth / Login (driver)" first: the token is saved automatically. Demo accounts (password "password"): admin@mishwar.test (super admin), moderator@mishwar.test, support@mishwar.test, driver@mishwar.test, passenger@mishwar.test.
